create_annotation_file: create an annotation JSON file for a given language code by downloading images and captions
use_Crossmodal3600_dataset: use the Crossmodal3600 VisionDataset class to load image-caption pairs from an annotation file
download_captions: download and extract the Crossmodal-3600 captions zip file to a specified output directory
download_images: download and extract the Crossmodal-3600 images tarball to a specified output directory
get_dataset_length: get the number of image-caption pairs in a Crossmodal3600 dataset instance
